title: Paper Wildflower Arts and Crafts Workshop in Denver
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the joy of creativity in this Paper Wildflower Workshop designed for relaxation and self-expression. Begin with gentle breathwork and calming meditation to center your mind, followed by a step-by-step guide to crafting unique paper flowers. Personalize each bloom with colors and details that represent your style, leaving with a beautiful piece of art and a reminder to nurture your creativity. This workshop is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, connect with nature, and engage in a mindful artistic experience.

• Combines mindfulness with a hands-on creative activity 
• Learn to sculpt and decorate your own paper flowers 
• Create a flower that reflects your own colors, energy, and style 
• A gentle, restorative experience for stress relief and self-expression 
• Perfect for anyone seeking a mindful reset, a creative outlet, or a fun activity to share with friends
